title: Derived self-tensor for a flat surjection
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is flat as an $A$-module. Then the canonical multiplication morphism $B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B\to B[0]$ is an isomorphism in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 08R2 (lemma-when-zero), cases (1)--(2): a flat epimorphism is a special case of the flat diagonal case; the derived tensor is represented by the ordinary tensor under flatness
